decision_rule: The maintainer accepted the offline-dfir-triage scope for v1.0. The listed axiom-scan contract becomes stable only when v1.0.0 is released; it is not a stability promise before that release.

commands.rules: Validate and count a positional rule file; success report has rules_count and rules.
commands.scan: Scan the full target byte buffer; provide the rule file with --rules <path>.
commands.pcap: Scan each classic PCAP record's captured bytes independently as opaque bytes; provide the rule file with --rules <path>; the linktype is ignored and no stream reassembly is performed.

validated_platform_scope.Windows: Compiler/native smoke and harmless scanner onboarding sentinel only; full file and PCAP workflows are not validated.
validated_platform_scope.macOS: Compiler/native smoke and harmless scanner onboarding sentinel only; full file and PCAP workflows are not validated.

options.--rules <path>: Required by scan and pcap; rules takes its rule file positionally.
options.--fail-on-match: Applies only to scan and pcap; returns 10 when those commands find at least one match.

exit_codes.0: A success report was produced. For scan and pcap, this means there were no findings or --fail-on-match was not supplied; rules succeeds with 0.
exit_codes.10: --fail-on-match was supplied and at least one finding was produced.

stdout.machine_reports: Exactly one JSON object for rules, scan, pcap, and structured errors.

report_schema.unknown_fields: Rejected; any report-field contract change requires incrementing schema_version.

input_contract.file_scan: Scan all bytes, including bytes after NUL; scanned_bytes and target_sha256 cover the complete file. The current implementation reads the full target into memory and has no configured maximum file size or memory guarantee.

resource_limits.file_scan_memory_model: Whole-target in-memory buffer; memory use scales with input size and very large inputs may exhaust available memory.

input_contract.regex_with_nul: Reject explicitly because the current regex path cannot preserve byte spans across NUL.

pcap.scan_unit: Each captured record byte sequence independently as opaque bytes; no link-layer or protocol parsing is performed.
pcap.linktype: The global-header linktype value is ignored and not validated.
pcap.packets_array: Contains only records with at least one matching rule; each index is the zero-based original record index.
pcap.match_count: Total matching rule-record pairs, equal to the sum of each emitted packet's rules array length; not pattern occurrence count.
pcap.timestamp_handling: Classic microsecond/nanosecond magic is accepted, but timestamp fractions are neither validated nor reported.
pcap.malformed_or_truncated_records: Invalid or truncated global/record headers and record payloads are rejected with a structured error report.

implementation_contract.ownership_and_lifetime: The executable owns rule and target buffers for one invocation. JSON output contains copied scalar/string data and does not expose borrowed pointers. All resources are released when the process exits.
implementation_contract.backend_parity: The C and LLVM builds must produce equivalent JSON values and exit codes for the same supported input, except for explicitly documented platform availability limits.
implementation_contract.concurrency: One scan command processes its target sequentially; no thread-safety or concurrent mutation guarantee is made for files changed while they are being read.
implementation_contract.supported_runtime_platform: Full file and classic-PCAP scanning is supported and validated on Linux x86_64. Other platforms are outside this stable surface until equivalent scanner workflow CI exists.

yara_subset.comments: # is not a comment marker; it is used by the #a occurrence-count operator.

text_patterns.fullword_boundary: ASCII matches reject adjacent ASCII alphanumeric bytes; wide matches reject adjacent ASCII alphanumeric two-byte code units. Neither treats underscore as alphanumeric.
text_patterns.wide_semantics: For text strings, interleaves ASCII pattern bytes with NUL bytes; wide alone searches only that form, while ascii wide searches both forms. Not arbitrary Unicode UTF-16. Reported offsets and lengths are byte-based.

hex_patterns.occurrence_semantics: At a shared start offset, a bounded jump chooses the shortest valid match; same-offset alternation branches count as one occurrence.

yara_subset.regex: POSIX ERE subject to documented validation and safety checks; YARA string modifiers are not accepted on regex patterns. Successful regex witnesses report the byte offset and length of the first regex match. Regex occurrence count/offset/index operators are rejected; regex on a NUL-containing target is rejected.

conditions.zero_of_them: 0 of them is true only when no pattern matches.
conditions.selector_accounting: Each selected pattern contributes independently; a pattern selected both by a wildcard group and explicitly contributes twice.

limitations: This does not stabilize the general Axiom language grammar or every compiler/stdlib symbol used internally by the example.
External YARA differential coverage is a pinned sample, not proof of complete YARA compatibility.

The accepted v1.0 profile stabilizes only the axiom-scan executable contract. The Axiom language, compiler CLI, package manager, manifests, lockfiles, registry, LSP, general standard library, and generated C/LLVM output are not part of this allowlist and carry no compatibility promise.
